summary: Implemented deterministic offline intake for raw fixture Polymarket-style crypto numeric market records. The parser normalizes supported BTC/ETH above/below target markets into scorer fixture format and rejects unsupported or ambiguous records with reason codes and short reasons.
limitations: Fixture-only parser; it does not fetch live markets, prices, APIs, or external metadata.
Target extraction intentionally requires dollar-denominated numeric targets in the question text.
No runtime integration, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, real orders, live trading, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-009-CRYPTO-NUMERIC-INTAKE-TO-CHAIN: connect normalized intake output to the existing offline scorer/review/plan chain as a local fixture-only command.
